entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-11-10
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.SaasPlatform.SaasServiceMgmt.V1 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.SaasPlatform.SaasServiceMgmt.V1

Google.Cloud.BackupDR.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta03

New features

  • Add Backup and DR Restore Verification v1beta public protobuf definitions

Google.Cloud.VectorSearch.V1 version 1.3.0

New features

  • Added structured query support to text search via TextSearch.structured_query (StructuredQuery, TextQuery, UnaryQuery, CombinedQuery, QueryEnhancement)

Documentation improvements

  • Documented filter expression syntax, supported operators, nesting limits and ANN vs. KNN filter restrictions
  • Clarified that OutputFields are opt-in and that "*" returns all fields

Google.Cloud.Ces.V1 version 1.1.0

New features

  • Add api_authentication, stateful_agent, input_variable_mapping, and output_variable_mapping to RemoteAgentTool

Google.Cloud.AuditManager.V1 version 1.4.0

New features

  • Add parameter_overrides field to GenerateAuditReportRequest, GenerateAuditScopeReportRequest, and AuditSchedule
  • Add cloud_control_parameter_states output field to AuditReport
  • Add Parameter, ParamValue, StringList, ParameterOverrides, ParameterState, and CloudControlParameterStates messages

Google.Cloud.HypercomputeCluster.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta02

New features

  • Add existing_instances.networks to ComputeEngineOrchestrator in v1beta
  • Add ComputeEngineOrchestrator, ManagedInstanceGroup, ExistingInstances, and Disk messages to v1beta
  • Add ListNodes RPC and Node, SlurmNodeDetails, and ComputeEngineNodeDetails messages to v1beta
  • Add BootDisk, PerformClusterNodeMaintenanceRequest, and OperationProgress steps to v1beta

Bug fixes

  • Update Lustre resource reference type to lustre.googleapis.com/Instance and mark SlurmNodeSet.compute_id as REQUIRED

Documentation improvements

  • Update documentation and resource definitions in v1beta proto definitions

Google.Ads.DataManager.V1 version 1.0.0-beta12

New features

  • Add ReportingService with the RetrievePartnerMatchReport method for retrieving Partner Match reports for data partners
  • Add PartnerMatchReportEntry and related messages (PartnerMatchAdvertiserAccount, PartnerMatchCampaign, PartnerMatchAdGroup, PartnerMatchUserList, PartnerMatchLineItem) for Partner Match report rows
  • Add CallInfo message and call_info field to Event for sending information about the phone call that led to an event
  • Add lead_id to AdIdentifiers for sending the Google-generated ID issued when a user submits a lead form
  • Add record_indices to ErrorCount and WarningCount to identify the records in the request that had each error or warning reason
  • Add INVALID_DATE, ENCRYPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED_ACCOUNT_TYPE_FOR_USER_LIST_DIRECT_LICENSE, DUPLICATE_ELEMENTS, UNSUPPORTED_BASELINE_LOCATION, and CONVERSION_PRECEDES_CALL values to the ErrorReason enum
  • Deprecate the unused REQUIRED_PREREQUISITE_LINK_MISSING value of the ErrorReason enum
  • Add PROCESSING_ERROR_REASON_DESTINATION_TOO_RECENTLY_CREATED, PROCESSING_ERROR_REASON_EXPIRED_CLICK, PROCESSING_ERROR_REASON_TOO_RECENT_CALL, PROCESSING_ERROR_REASON_EXPIRED_CALL, and PROCESSING_ERROR_REASON_INVALID_CALL values to the ProcessingErrorReason enum
  • Add PROCESSING_WARNING_REASON_CUSTOM_VARIABLE_NOT_ENABLED and PROCESSING_WARNING_REASON_CUSTOM_VARIABLE_NOT_PREDEFINED values to the ProcessingWarningReason enum
  • Add INVALID_NUMBER_FORMAT value to the WarningReason enum

Documentation improvements

  • Document the required login-account authorization header for the IngestAdEvents method
  • Update the descriptions of the estimated member count fields of UserList to clarify that they count active members over the last 30 days
  • Update the description of USER_IDENTIFIER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED to refer to records instead of audience members
  • Update links to Google Analytics recommended events and user properties documentation

Google.Cloud.GeminiDataAnalytics.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta14

New features

  • Add ListMessagesRequest.pending_write_wait_skipped to skip waiting for in-flight writes on the most recent turn

Documentation improvements

  • Clarify BigQuery Agent Analytics field behavior and validation on DataAgent

Google.Cloud.Dataform.V1 version 1.3.0

New features

  • Added method CreateCompilationResultLongRunning and message CreateCompilationResultMetadata to service Dataform
  • Added support for BigQuery unit tests with BigQueryUnitTest in CompilationResultAction and BigQueryUnitTestAction in WorkflowInvocationAction
  • Added fields concurrent_actions_limit and execution_mode to message .google.cloud.dataform.v1.InvocationConfig
  • Added state QUEUED to enum .google.cloud.dataform.v1.WorkflowInvocationAction.State

Documentation improvements

  • Updated documentation and field descriptions in FileSearchResult and InvocationConfig

Google.Cloud.ModelArmor.V1 version 1.3.0

New features

  • Add CsamFilterSettings and csam_filter_settings to FilterConfig for configuring CSAM detection enforcement and confidence thresholds

Documentation improvements

  • Update filter_rule_settings documentation comment in FilterConfig
